runs.text: When an expression has several operators, precedence decides which applies first:
. Higher levels grab their operands first. From strongest to weakest:

blocks.description: Nine steps from top to bottom: postfix; sign and Not; power; product, division, div and mod; sum, subtraction and concatenation; order; equality; And; Or. Unary operators and power associate to the right.

caption.text: The precedence levels, from the one that binds tightest (top) to the one that binds loosest (bottom).

blocks.description: The expression 2 + 3 * 4 is grouped as a tree with + at the root, 2 on the left and 3 * 4 on the right. The product reduces to 12 and the sum to 14.

caption.text: is grouped. The product sits lower in the tree because it is computed first.
